|ingredients = {{Name|Iron Bar|1}}{{Name|Coal|2}} |sellprice = 20 |quality = false |recipe = [[File:Combat Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Combat]] Level 8 |produces = 5 Explosive Ammo per craft }} '''Explosive Ammo''' is a one-time use item that damages anything within its explosion radius. Unlike other [[Crafting#Bombs|explosive items]], it must be used with a [[Weapons#Slingshot|slingshot]]. The Explosive Ammo crafting recipe is unlocked at [[Combat]] Level 8. For each time it's crafted, the player will get 5 pieces of Explosive Ammo. After the recipe is unlocked, it can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|300}} each. To equip a slingshot with explosive ammo, select the ammo, then {{key|Right-Click}} on the slingshot. Ammo will detonate when it hits an enemy, the wall of a cave, a ladder, or water. Otherwise, it will pass straight through other objects, such as rocks or plants. ==Radius== Explosive Ammo has a radius of 2 tiles.
